name: python-skills
description: Agent skills for Python projects and their toolchain

interface.shortDescription: Set up Python projects on the uv toolchain
interface.longDescription: Create and modernize Python projects with the uv toolchain - uv for packages and environments, Ruff for lint and format, pytest for tests, ty for type checking, and pre-commit to run them on every commit - including turning a loose script or a pip and requirements.txt project into a proper src-layout package.
